title: Grusch on JRE: CIA psi programs as a key to stored craft

tellings.quote: Remember what Grush said on uh JRE uh you know they they started talking about remote viewing stuff and and David Grush says well what if the CIA started looking into this as a sigh stuff as a possible solution to serve as a key to unlock some stuff we have sitting around in a warehouse.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb recalls something David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower, said in 2024 on Joe Rogan's podcast. As UAPGerb tells it, when talk turned to remote viewing, the claimed ability to see distant places with the mind, Grusch wondered aloud whether the CIA had studied such psychic abilities as a way to unlock craft the government keeps in a warehouse. If true, it would mean mind powers were treated as a key to non-human technology.
